# Dominion Fortress

> Dominion Fortress is an AI-native technology, cybersecurity and intelligence company providing practical services and public assessment tools for organizations.

## Primary platform
- Platform: https://dominion-fortress.com/platform/
- Intelligence: https://dominion-fortress.com/intelligence/
- Tools: https://dominion-fortress.com/tools/
- Start a project: https://dominion-fortress.com/get-started/

## Primary focus
- Cybersecurity: authorized penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, external attack surface assessment, red team testing, defensive security, incident response, digital forensics and threat intelligence.
- AI & Automation: AI strategy, workflow automation, AI agents, LLM integrations, RAG, data workflows and AI security/governance.
- IT & Cloud: cloud infrastructure, migration, networking, managed IT, DevOps and automation.
- Software Development: web applications, APIs, SaaS, mobile applications, backend and full-stack engineering.
- Data & Analytics: data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, machine learning and reporting.
- Digital Growth: SEO, technical SEO, AEO, GEO/AI-search visibility, content, CRO and digital marketing.
- Finance & Accounting: bookkeeping, financial analysis, FP&A, financial reporting, modeling and advisory services.
- Consulting: technology strategy, digital transformation, automation, operations and technology advisory.

## Live public tool
- Domain Security Scanner: https://dominion-fortress.com/tools/domain-security-scanner/
- The current scanner performs passive public-signal checks including HTTPS reachability, HTTP status, security headers, DNS A/AAAA/MX/NS, SPF, DMARC, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and security.txt.
- Scanner output is an automated public-signal assessment and is not a penetration test.

## Acquisition and sales flow
Visitor -> useful content/tool -> scan -> lead capture -> qualification -> WhatsApp Business -> proposal -> project/retainer.

## Security principles
All cybersecurity assessments require appropriate client authorization and defined scope. Do not infer that automated public scanning authorizes intrusive testing.
